verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only general PostgreSQL wire-protocol compatibility, meaning any PostgreSQL client driver can connect. That is a driver-level building block, not documented out-of-the-box support for specific ORMs or frameworks. The pack has no guides or compatibility statements for Prisma, Drizzle, Django, or Rails, so the story is applicable but unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, the database works out of the box with my ORM and framework (Prisma, Drizzle, Django, Rails) with documented guides
